clusters.name: The AI Code Surge
signals: Org-wide rollout of AI coding assistants (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code)
Building AI agents, LLM apps or MCP servers
Open AppSec, DevSecOps or Product Security role posted in the last 45 days
clusters.why: The company is producing more code, of a newer kind, than its security team can see, and it has just admitted the gap by hiring for it.
play: Target the Head of AppSec or the hiring manager on the open role, plus the Head of AI Platform.
Lead with Snyk Studio: guardrails inside the AI assistant developers already use.
Follow with an AI-BOM scan of a public repo, then an Evo conversation for the agent work.
Reach out within 2 weeks of the posting, before the new hire picks their own stack.

clusters.name: The Compliance Clock
signals: EU Cyber Resilience Act work (SBOM, PSIRT, vulnerability reporting)
Opening an EU entity, office or product line
Compliance programme in flight (PCI DSS, FedRAMP, SOC 2)
clusters.why: A dated obligation (CRA reporting today, SBOMs by December 2027, or an audit) has landed on a company that ships into regulated markets.
play: Target the Director of Product Security, with the CISO copied on the second touch.
Lead with the CRA-to-Snyk control map and the 24-hour reporting problem.
Offer an SBOM generation workshop, then a scoped evaluation.
Expect 4 to 8 weeks from signal to first meeting; the deadline sets the pace.

clusters.name: The New Sheriff
signals: New CISO, Head of AppSec or Head of Product Security in the last 120 days
Open AppSec, DevSecOps or Product Security role posted in the last 45 days
Legacy SAST (Checkmarx, Veracode) named in job postings
clusters.why: A new security leader is building a team on top of an incumbent tool developers don't use. The stack is up for review.
play: Target the new leader directly in their first 60 days.
Lead with a peer benchmark, not a demo.
Offer a side-by-side scan against the incumbent on one repo.
Bring in the VP Engineering once the leader agrees there's a developer-adoption problem.

clusters.name: The Champion Returns
signals: Former Snyk user joins a non-customer in a security or platform role
Several developers from one company signing up for Snyk Free
Open AppSec, DevSecOps or Product Security role posted in the last 45 days
clusters.why: A former Snyk user has joined, developers are already trying Snyk Free, and a security role is open. Adoption is pulling from the inside.
play: Target the former user first, then the engineering manager behind the sign-ups.
Lead with a fast-start offer that connects existing free accounts into one org.
Route straight to an AE; skip nurture.
Move within 2 weeks; this cluster cools quickly.

templates.name: Awareness: new security leader
templates.persona: New CISO or Head of AppSec
templates.hook: Congrats on the new role at {Company}
templates.body: Congrats on joining {Company}. Most AppSec leaders I talk to spend their first 90 days figuring out what developers actually use versus what's licensed. We put together a short benchmark of how teams your size structure that first quarter. Happy to send it over.

templates.name: High intent: the AI Code Surge
templates.hook: {Company}'s AI coding rollout and the AppSec role you're hiring for
templates.body:
Hi {FirstName},

Saw that {Company} rolled out {AI tool} across engineering and is hiring a {open role}. That combination usually means more code is shipping than the security team can see.

Snyk Studio runs inside the assistant your developers already use, so issues get caught before the code is committed rather than in a backlog later. {Reference customer} used it to {outcome}.

Would a 20-minute look at what that would mean for your repos be useful?

templates.name: Compliance: the CRA clock
templates.body:
Hi {FirstName},

Since 11 September, manufacturers selling into the EU have 24 hours to flag an actively exploited vulnerability. The hard part isn't the form, it's knowing which of your releases contain the affected component.

We built a one-page map of which CRA obligations Snyk covers and which it doesn't. Want me to send it?

templates.name: Displacement: legacy SAST
templates.hook: Is {Incumbent} getting fixed or getting ignored?
templates.body:
Hi {FirstName},

Noticed {Company}'s postings still list {Incumbent}. The teams we talk to rarely complain about detection. They complain that developers don't act on the findings.

We can run Snyk side by side with {Incumbent} on one repo and compare what developers would actually fix. No migration, one afternoon.

templates.name: Cross-sell: Team plan ceiling
templates.hook: Your Snyk workspace just hit 10 developers
templates.body:
Hi {FirstName},

Your team at {Company} is at the Team plan's 10-developer limit, so the next person to commit won't be covered. I can walk you through what Ignite adds and price it against your actual contributor count.

templates.name: Champion: former Snyk user
templates.persona: Former Snyk user, now at a new company
templates.body: Congrats on the move to {Company}. You ran Snyk at {Previous company}, and a few developers at {Company} have already signed up for the free tier. Want help connecting them into one org so you start with a full picture?

data: Clay search filters and data points

eng_headcount_growth.indicates: More contributing developers and services every quarter, which outgrows manual review and per-team tooling (T7).
eng_headcount_growth.why_now: Security tooling decisions get made during the hiring wave, before new teams settle on their own scanners.
eng_headcount_growth.angle: Every new engineer is a new committer. Snyk's per-developer model scales coverage with the team instead of with the security headcount.
campaigns: Paid LinkedIn to VP Engineering at fast-growing companies with a 'security that scales with headcount' message
Quarterly growth-cohort sequence that pairs a growth stat with a short Snyk customer story from the same segment
eng_headcount_growth.detect: Clay search-companies: employee_growth_12mo >= 1.15, company_size 201-500 to 5,001-10,000, industry in Software Development / Financial Services. Refresh monthly.

growth_funding.indicates: New capital usually funds engineering hiring and the first formal security controls investors and enterprise buyers ask for (T7, T5).
growth_funding.why_now: Post-round companies set up SOC 2 and secure-SDLC basics within two quarters to unblock enterprise deals.
growth_funding.angle: Enterprise buyers will ask how you secure your code and dependencies. Snyk gives you the evidence without slowing the roadmap.
campaigns: Congratulations-plus-checklist email: the five AppSec controls enterprise security reviews ask for
Founder or CTO dinner for recently funded companies in one city
growth_funding.detect: Clay: Latest Funding data point (or a workspace funding subroutine) filtered to rounds >= $30M in 90 days; cross-check round type in Crunchbase.

eu_market_entry.indicates: Products placed on the EU market fall under the Cyber Resilience Act regardless of where the manufacturer is based (T4).
eu_market_entry.why_now: CRA reporting duties are already live, and the full SBOM obligations follow in December 2027.
eu_market_entry.angle: Selling into the EU now means a 24-hour clock on exploited vulnerabilities. Know what's in every release before the clock starts.
campaigns: CRA readiness webinar for US companies expanding into Europe
One-page CRA-to-Snyk control map sent to new EU entrants
eu_market_entry.detect: Clay custom data point on EU expansion, plus search filter locations.any(region = "EMEA") compared month over month.

appsec_hiring.indicates: The company is building or expanding the team that owns AppSec tooling (T1).
appsec_hiring.why_now: New AppSec hires usually pick or review the toolset in their first 90 days, so the window opens when the posting goes up.
appsec_hiring.angle: Your new AppSec engineer will be outnumbered by developers. Give them a platform developers actually use, so they spend time on risk, not triage.
campaigns: Sequence to the hiring manager referencing the open role and the developer-to-security ratio
Content offer: '30-60-90 day plan for a new AppSec engineer' guide
Retargeting ads to the company's engineering org during the hiring window
appsec_hiring.detect: Clay search-companies with jobs.exists(job_still_open = true and job_posted_date >= today() - interval 45 days and job_title is_similar_to ("Application Security Engineer", "DevSecOps Engineer", "Product Security Engineer")). Free; this is the signal behind the live board.

first_security_hire.indicates: Security is moving from 'the CTO handles it' to a dedicated function, which is the Ignite tier's sweet spot (T1).
first_security_hire.why_now: The first hire often inherits a vendor decision the CTO wants made before they arrive.
first_security_hire.angle: Your first security hire shouldn't spend month one setting up scanners. Start them on a platform that already runs in your repos.
campaigns: CTO-to-CTO email with a 'first security hire' playbook
Ignite-tier trial offer timed to the posting
first_security_hire.detect: Clay search-companies: company_size in ("51-200","201-500") and jobs.exists(security engineer titles) and people.count(is_current = true and job_title is_similar_to ("Security Engineer")) = 0.

platform_team_formation.indicates: The company is standardising golden paths for building and shipping software, and security checks get baked into those paths (T7).
platform_team_formation.why_now: Golden paths are designed once; tools that make it in early stay for years.
platform_team_formation.angle: Put security in the golden path so every new service starts scanned, without a ticket to the security team.
campaigns: Platform engineering meetup sponsorship
Technical guide: adding Snyk to an internal developer platform
platform_team_formation.detect: Clay search filter jobs.exists(job_title is_similar_to ("Platform Engineer", "Developer Experience Engineer")) with jobs.count >= 2.

ai_coding_rollout.indicates: Code volume is rising faster than human review, and much of it is generated (T2).
ai_coding_rollout.why_now: Security leaders are being asked whether AI-generated code is safe after the rollout, not before.
ai_coding_rollout.angle: Your developers ship more code with AI assistants than your reviewers can read. Snyk Studio puts guardrails inside the assistant they already use.
campaigns: 'Secure your AI coding rollout' assessment offer
Joint content with AI coding tool partners
Webinar on measuring the security of AI-generated code
ai_coding_rollout.detect: Clay custom data point (prompt in signals.yaml). Supplement with job descriptions mentioning Copilot, Cursor or Claude Code.

cloud_native_shift.indicates: A growing container and IaC estate creates misconfiguration and base-image risk (T7).
cloud_native_shift.why_now: Container and IaC scanning is easiest to add while pipelines are being built.
cloud_native_shift.angle: Every Terraform module and base image is code. Scan it in the same workflow developers already use for their app code.
campaigns: Container base-image risk report for their public images
Terraform misconfiguration workshop
cloud_native_shift.detect: Clay search filter jobs.exists(job_description contains ("Kubernetes", "Terraform")) with jobs.count >= 3; technographics.any(product contains "Kubernetes") where covered.

legacy_sast_in_stack.indicates: An incumbent enterprise SAST tool is in place, often with low developer adoption (T8).
legacy_sast_in_stack.why_now: Postings that list the tool show it is still in use; renewal timing is the open question.
legacy_sast_in_stack.angle: If developers ignore your scanner, the findings don't get fixed. Snyk runs where they already work.
campaigns: Side-by-side scan offer on one repo
Migration guide from Checkmarx or Veracode
legacy_sast_in_stack.detect: Clay search filter jobs.exists(job_still_open = true and job_description contains ("Checkmarx", "Veracode")).

bundle_adoption.indicates: The buyer is consolidating AppSec into a platform they already pay for, which puts best-of-breed tools at risk (T8).
bundle_adoption.why_now: Consolidation decisions are often made at a platform renewal; arriving after it is too late.
bundle_adoption.angle: Consolidating is fine, until coverage drops. Show where a bundled scanner misses dependencies, containers or fix guidance.
campaigns: Coverage gap analysis against the bundled tool
Customer reference from a company that kept Snyk alongside a CNAPP
bundle_adoption.detect: Clay search filter jobs.exists(job_description contains ("GitHub Advanced Security", "CodeQL", "Wiz")); technographics where available.

new_security_leader.indicates: A new leader reviews the inherited stack and programme (T1).
new_security_leader.why_now: New leaders usually set a 90-day plan; tool changes land in it or wait a year.
new_security_leader.angle: Congratulations on the new role. Here's what developer-led security programmes look like in their first 90 days at companies your size.
campaigns: New-leader welcome kit: benchmark, peer intros, 90-day plan
Invite to a CISO roundtable
new_security_leader.detect: Clay search-contacts at ICP accounts: experiences.any(is_current = true and job_title is_similar_to ("CISO", "Head of Application Security") and start_date >= today() - interval 4 months).

snyk_champion_moved.indicates: Someone who already trusts Snyk now sits inside a new account (T1).
snyk_champion_moved.why_now: People bring tools they know in their first few months in a new job.
snyk_champion_moved.angle: You ran Snyk at your last company. Want to set it up here before the backlog builds?
campaigns: Alumni-champion sequence with a fast-start offer
Champion programme invite
snyk_champion_moved.detect: Clay search-contacts: experiences.any(is_current = false and description contains "Snyk") and experiences.any(is_current = true and start_date >= today() - interval 4 months and job_title is_similar_to (security and platform titles)); cross-check Snyk CRM.

eu_cra_exposure.indicates: The company is building the vulnerability handling and SBOM process the CRA requires (T4).
eu_cra_exposure.why_now: Reporting duties have applied since 11 September 2026, and SBOMs become mandatory on 11 December 2027.
eu_cra_exposure.angle: You can't report an exploited vulnerability in 24 hours if you don't know which releases contain it. Snyk keeps that inventory current.
campaigns: CRA readiness assessment
SBOM generation workshop
Partner campaign with EU compliance consultancies
eu_cra_exposure.detect: Clay search filter jobs.exists(job_description contains ("Cyber Resilience Act", "PSIRT", "SBOM")) and locations.any(region = "EMEA").

compliance_push.indicates: An audit is coming that will ask for code and dependency scanning evidence (T5).
compliance_push.why_now: Audit dates are fixed, so the purchase has a deadline.
compliance_push.angle: Turn audit evidence into a by-product of the way developers already work.
campaigns: PCI DSS or FedRAMP control mapping one-pager
Case study: Revolut on updated PCI standards
compliance_push.detect: Clay search filter jobs.exists(job_description contains ("PCI DSS", "FedRAMP", "SOC 2")).

ai_agent_build.indicates: New attack surface (prompt injection, tool calls, model supply chain) that classic SAST doesn't cover (T3).
ai_agent_build.why_now: Teams are shipping agents to production now and security reviews are catching up.
ai_agent_build.angle: Your agents call tools and pull models you didn't write. AI-BOM shows what's in the chain, and Evo tests it.
campaigns: AI-BOM scan of a public repo
Agent security workshop for AI platform teams
ai_agent_build.detect: Clay search filter jobs.exists(job_description contains ("MCP", "agentic", "LLM")) with jobs.count >= 2; public GitHub repos containing MCP server code.

security_incident.indicates: Leadership now has budget and urgency to prevent a repeat (T6).
security_incident.why_now: Post-incident budgets are approved within weeks and spent within a quarter.
security_incident.angle: Lead with help, not a pitch: what to check in your dependencies right now.
campaigns: Offer a free dependency exposure check
Executive briefing on supply-chain controls
security_incident.detect: Clay custom data point or Recent News filtered for breach terms; news alerts for 'breach' or 'compromised package' with company names.

ai_product_launch.indicates: AI is now in production and in front of customers (T3).
ai_product_launch.why_now: Customers and auditors start asking how the AI feature is secured soon after launch.
ai_product_launch.angle: Your customers will ask how your new AI feature is secured. Have the answer ready.
campaigns: Congratulations note plus AI security FAQ template
Webinar: securing AI features after launch
ai_product_launch.detect: Clay Recent News data point filtered for AI, agent or copilot launches.

ipo_prep.indicates: Controls and risk disclosures, including software supply-chain risk, are being formalised (T5).
ipo_prep.why_now: Pre-IPO companies tighten controls in the year before listing.
ipo_prep.angle: Public-company cyber disclosures start with knowing your software risk. Snyk makes it measurable.
campaigns: Pre-IPO security readiness checklist
CISO roundtable for pre-IPO companies
ipo_prep.detect: SEC EDGAR S-1 alerts; Clay Recent News for IPO preparation.

snyk_content_engagement.indicates: A buying group is researching together (T1, T2).
snyk_content_engagement.why_now: Multi-person engagement usually precedes a formal evaluation by weeks.
snyk_content_engagement.angle: Several of your team have been reading about X. Want a session tailored to what they're looking at?
campaigns: Account-level follow-up summarising what the team read
Invite to a technical deep-dive
snyk_content_engagement.detect: First-party: marketing automation account roll-up by domain. Not available in Clay.

oss_vuln_exposure.indicates: Hygiene gaps that are visible from outside (T6).
oss_vuln_exposure.angle: We noticed a critical issue in one of your public repos. Here's the fix, no strings attached.
campaigns: Responsible 'we found this' outreach with the fix
Open-source maintainer programme invite
oss_vuln_exposure.detect: Scan the company's public GitHub org with Snyk or OSV; map org to domain. Not available in Clay.

team_plan_ceiling.indicates: Snyk is already in use and has hit the Team plan's hard limit (T7).
team_plan_ceiling.why_now: The team can't add the 11th developer without talking to sales.
team_plan_ceiling.angle: You've outgrown the Team plan. Here's what Ignite adds, sized to your team.
campaigns: In-product upgrade prompt plus AE outreach
Usage review call showing current coverage
team_plan_ceiling.detect: First-party product data: contributor count on the Usage page per organisation. Not available in Clay.

free_tier_cluster.indicates: Bottom-up adoption ahead of a team decision (T2).
free_tier_cluster.why_now: Grassroots usage turns into a team purchase or fizzles out within weeks.
free_tier_cluster.angle: A few of your developers are already using Snyk. Want to connect it to your org so their results are shared?
campaigns: Product-qualified lead routing to SDRs
Team onboarding webinar
free_tier_cluster.detect: First-party sign-ups grouped by email domain; enrich the domain with Clay for firmographics.

g2_category_research.why_now: Review-site research typically happens in the final weeks of a shortlist.
g2_category_research.angle: Comparing AppSec tools? Here's a fair comparison on your own code.
campaigns: Comparison-page retargeting
Bake-off offer on a real repo
g2_category_research.detect: G2 buyer intent feed. Not available in Clay.
